sources.title: ISLES: Ischemic Stroke Lesion Segmentation Challenge 2022
sources.snippet: This year ISLES 2022 asks for methods that allow the segmentation of stroke lesions in two separate tasks: Multimodal MRI infarct segmentation in acute and sub-acute stroke. Participants are requested to Segment brain infarct lesions from acute and sub-acute stroke scans using DWI, ADC and FLAIR images.
